notes:
Image support is now available to everyone.
Improved editor stability and reliability.
Characters can be organized into folders with filters.
Fixed scene sync and data saving issues.
Redesigned project import (Scrivener support).
Fixed multiple Android UI issues.
Minor fixes and performance improvements.
